bear.rationale: AI data center buildout cools faster than expected. Competition from Schneider Electric and Eaton pressures margins. Valuation compresses to industrial mean.

base.rationale: Aligned with analyst consensus. Vertiv captures significant share of liquid cooling market for Blackwell/AI clusters. Margins expand on operating leverage.

bull.rationale: Hypergrowth scenario. AI power density requirements force rapid retrofit of legacy datacenters, driving a 'supercycle' for thermal management. VRT becomes a de facto standard.

aiThesis.rationale: Vertiv (VRT) is a critical infrastructure play for the AI boom. Our DCF analysis suggests the stock is Fairly Valued (Weighted Fair Value $230 vs Price $235). While growth is strong (22%+), the 69x PE prices in perfection. We recommend HOLD/BUY ON DIPS.
